title: A Little Game
description: You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...

mainQuestExcel.title: A Little Game
mainQuestExcel.description: You met a strange person on Mt. Tianheng who is looking for someone to play hide-and-seek with him...

dialogs.text: Are you ready to play hide-and-seek with me now?
Are you ready to play hide-and-seek with me now?
Hee-hee, see? Told you you'd never find me, didn't I!
Well, since it's your first time playing, I'll give you a little clue.
I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>behind a rock</color>. You just gotta a look a little harder! You wanna carry on playing?
Still can't find me?
Seems like I'm pretty good at this! Hmm... Maybe I should go easier on you.
I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>to the north</color>. You just gotta a look a little harder! You wanna carry on playing?
Was I really so well hidden? Hmm, this must be getting pretty boring for you if you can't find me.
I'm hiding near a <color=#00E1FFFF>a big rock to the north</color>.
Alright, let's go again shall we? Surely you'll be able to find me this time.
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>behind a rock</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is in the <color=#00E1FFFF>north</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is near a <color=#00E1FFFF>big rock to the north</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
Give up?
Hmm... Okay, I'll give you a little clue. This time, I'll be hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>near one of the trees round here</color>.
Let's have another round, you'll definitely be able to find me this time. Well? You wanna carry on playing?
Still couldn't find me? Maybe you're just not very good at this kind of game...
Here's a tip: Try looking <color=#00E1FFFF>further northwest</color>. I'm hiding over that way.
Let's go again. You ready?
...Have you ever even played this game before?
Ugh, it's hopeless... You'll never find me at this rate.
Look out for a <color=#00E1FFFF>tree on the slope to the northwest</color>.
Surely you must be able to find me now... Let's give it another try.
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>next to one of the trees round here</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?

My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>in a tree on the slope to the north</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
Haha, guess you couldn't find me after all?
Well, it is a pretty neat hiding place. My daddy found it for me, even Mommy can't find me there.
There's no way you can compete with my daddy at this game, so I'll have to give you a clue. My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>nearby that house over there</color>.
See, you couldn't find me, right? Haha, well this hiding place was picked by my dad, after all.
I'll have to give you a clue, otherwise you'll never find me. So, try heading <color=#00E1FFFF>east</color> next time.
Let's go again! You can do it, you just need to look a little harder.
Couldn't find me, huh?
Don't feel bad — my daddy found the hiding place for me, so normal people would never be able to find it.
Here's a tip: Look out for <color=#00E1FFFF>hidey holes around that house to the east</color>.
As tips go, that was a pretty big one. So surely you should be able to find me now.
Let's go again! You can do it, you just need to look a little harder.
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>nearby that house</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>to the east</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>nearby that house to the east</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
Hmm... Well, this is the ultimate hiding place, I guess.
Okay, a hint: I'm hiding <color=#00E1FFFF>by the cliff</color>. Look carefully!
Let's give it another go.
Still can't find me... Alright, I guess you're allowed another clue.
The clue is: Look further <color=#00E1FFFF>south</color>.
Got it? Let's try again, you should be able to find me this time.
My ultimate hiding place is even better than I thought. Seems like you'll never find me there...
Since you're having so much trouble finding me... Try looking by the <color=#00E1FFFF>big cliff at the south</color>.
Hee-hee... Who knows what you might find there — maybe me!
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>next to the cliff</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is in the <color=#00E1FFFF>south</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
My hiding place is <color=#00E1FFFF>next to the cliff in the south</color>. Do you wanna carry on playing hide-and-seek with me?
Ah, you found me! Was it that obvious?
It was pretty obvious...
Really? How could that be? When I hid here, even my father couldn't find me...
Hmph. We've only just begun. I haven't used my full power yet!

Ah, you found me!
Hee-hee, was I well hidden or what? This is my secret hiding place. Even Mommy can't find me here!
That tree doesn't hide you completely.
I don't believe you! I'm tiny and this tree hides me perfectly, even Daddy says so.
My dad's really tall and it even hides him. There's no way it could hide him but not me.
Anyway, I guess you're just really good at this game. Let's play again!
Hmph, this time I'm gonna hide way out of sight. I know just the place, Daddy picked it for me...
My daddy's a Millelith, and he says that there's no one better than him at being stealthy.
Every time we've played hide-and-seek before, Mommy can never ever find me and Daddy until Daddy comes out on purpose... Or if Mommy yells at him to come out, that works too.
Aha, you finally found me.

Bet you won't find me this time!
What do you think of my daddy's specially chosen hiding place? Pretty well hidden, right?
What do you think of my daddy's specially chosen hiding place? Pretty well hidden, right?
Okay, this time I'm gonna go to... my ultimate hiding place! You'll never find me there.
You found me! Hehehe...
You found me! Hehehe...
Looks like this was kinda hard work for you.
Sure.
I need a break.
Looks like this was kinda hard work for you.
Nah, I'm fine.
Yeah, I need a rest.
Okay.
Actually, I need a break.
So, are you ready?
It wasn't that hard to find.
Really? Well... At least, Mommy can never find me and Daddy when we're hiding here.
It was pretty hard to find.
See? See? Whenever me and Daddy hide here, Mommy can never find us and always has to tell us to come out.
Daddy's even hidden a load of cool stuff here like snacks, wine, and even some Mora! Daddy says I'm not supposed to tell Mommy about that part though.
But then this one time just as Daddy was leaving the house, he went and told Mommy about all the places where he was hiding stuff anyway.
But whatever, some of the stuff that goes on between mommies and daddies isn't meant for kids to understand. Let's keep playing, shall we?
I managed...
It's okay, there's no shame in admitting you found this a tough challenge. It is the ultimate hiding place, after all.
It was a little tough.
Haha, well, this is the ultimate hiding place after all. It's normal that finding it was a challenge.
Even Mommy's never found this place. One day, she suddenly said she wanted to play hide-and-seek with me, with me as the hider and her as the seeker.
So I went to a special hiding place that Daddy once told me about, and sure enough she couldn't find me at all. Then, I heard loads up people walking up the mountain...
I thought it must've been Mommy getting all her friends to help look for me. So I hid even further inside.
After a few days, she still hadn't found me. I thought she might be worried, and I was also a little hungry... so I came out. But she still didn't find me.
Maybe Mommy got mad because I was so well hidden that she couldn't find me? Still... I'd have thought that Mommy or Daddy would've found me by now, after such a long time...

But anyway, thanks for playing with me for so long. Mommy and Daddy always said I shouldn't take up too much of other people's time, and that when I get somebody to do something for me, I should always repay them.
So here you go, take these. They're from the hiding place that Daddy picked out for me.
This one time, a guy brought some food for me, and I wanted to repay him too, but he wouldn't take it. I have no idea why...
Okay, I'm going home. You can carry on with your other stuff now.
Let's play.
This time, I'm gonna hide in the best hiding place ever. You'll never find me!
Bet you won't find me this time!
